canonical_theme: Burbot and under-ice locksmiths: a smooth eel-bodied fish grows its single chin barbel into a key-bit organ and opens paired shutter-like fin folds to slip through sealed winter channels. The key is living anatomy, not a carried object.
canonical_eye_form: SOUTH exactly TWO isolated blacksquare pupils, WEST exactly ONE actual near pupil, all on broad LIGHT cheek/sclera. No mouth/nose dots, eye masks or goggle frames. Eyeplane clear of bodybars and barbels.

palette_binding.white_body_region_policy: Simplify formerly white body/highlight regions to light ink1. Index0 is transparent everywhere, not an opaque white paint color.

motion_contract: FISH SWIMMING, NO feet/legs/hands/ground. SOUTH head/snout toward bottom with tail behind towardtop; NORTH head points UP/AWAY, visible smooth back/headback NOeye dots, tail towardbottom; WEST true horizontal fish profile headLEFT/tailRIGHT. Foreshortened front/rear fish, never upright humanoid. Secondrow only tailfin and pectoralfin tips flex1logicalpixel for swimgait, same head/eye anchor, no bodybob. Fins are flat tapered appendages, no toes.
